narrative_purpose: Read the Mangkwan's fierce, extractive culture as adaptation to an arrested landscape: a settlement built in the dead Hometree's hollow roots, surviving on bone, scavenged metal and raiding because the ground grows nothing.
subject: A Na'vi settlement built inside the massive hollow collapsed roots of a destroyed Hometree on a grey ash plain: heavy hide yurts braced with giant bone struts and scavenged dull metal plates, a contained fire burning, a few tall dark-clad Mangkwan Na'vi figures, and one armored mountain banshee with pierced wing membranes perched on the root structure above.
scene: The hollow buttress-roots of a fallen Hometree rising like caverns over a barren grey ashland, thin fumarole haze in the distance, no vegetation.
camera: Mid-wide establishing shot taking in the root-shelter, the figures for scale, and the barren plain beyond.
light: The contained cookfire and forge-glow give a rare warm ember-amber pool of light inside the dark root cavern; the surrounding ashland stays cold grey-indigo.
palette: Cool grey ash and dark root-black dominant, one warm ember-amber hearth glow as the human focus, dull metal grey accents.
style: Painterly naturalist plate, a lived-in harsh settlement, observed not glamorised.
detail_level: High detail on the yurts, bone struts, scavenged metal and the perched banshee; plain recedes into haze.
composition: Root-cavern shelter filling one side with the warm hearth glow, figures small for scale, barren plain opening to the other side.
consistency_notes: Mangkwan / Ash People aesthetic: dark hides, bone, scavenged RDA metal, fire-centric, a barded pierced-wing banshee. Built in a dead Hometree's hollow roots on barren ash. Cool palette with one warm hearth accent.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no green vegetation, no modern buildings, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
